title: I Love It
text: I Love It. 100% better than I imagined or as pictured! I bought a “used”, expecting some kind of damage. It arrived in perfect condition. It’s very heavy at almost 19 lbs so, I’ll need help hanging it. Very happy with my purchase!

product_metadata.title: Howard Elliott Queen Ann Rectangular Hanging Wall Mirror, Beveled, Vanity, Glossy Royal Blue, 24 x 36 Inch
features: STUNNING FOCAL POINT - This traditional, antique inspired hanging wall mirror is a perfect focal point for an entryway, bathroom, bedroom or any room in your home
EMBELLISHED ACCENTS - The wood framed decorative mirror features a beaded textured inset and decorative adornments on each side of the frame, and is painted in a lovely glossy royal blue
BEAUTIFULLY BEVELED - For added detail and interest, the mirror’s edge features a one inch bevel
EASY TO HANG - With D-rings already affixed to the back of the mirror, it is ready to hang right out of the box in either a horizontal or vertical orientation!
DIMENSIONS - Rectangular wood framed hanging wall mirror measures 24" x 36" x 1.3/4"
description: The rectangular frame is made from wood and is accented with a beaded textured inset and decorative adornments on each side of the frame. For more added detail the mirror features a one inch bevel. Its Traditional style makes this mirror a favorite for bringing some flair to your decor. This simple yet stunning piece would be a great addition to any room. It is a perfect focal point for an entryway, bathroom, bedroom or any room in your home. D-rings are affixed to the back of the mirror so it is ready to hang right out of the box in either a horizontal or vertical orientation! Outer Dimensions: 24" x 36" x 1.3/4" ; Weight: 25 lbs. Country of Origin: China. Material: Wood
